Name: (SVE) Anime Portraits Replacer
Author: bunzbunzMODS
Description:
[size=3]More portraits for Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) characters:[b] Andy, Claire, Martin, Scarlett, and Victor[/b]. Will upload more for other characters once done. I made these with the intention of matching OhoDavi's "[i]stardewvalley anime mods[/i]" so I didn't make portraits for the characters that they already made for both original and SVE characters as of the date of this mod upload.

[b]!!NOTE[/b] that these are [b]REPLACERS[/b] for already existing portraits in the Stardew Valley Expansion MOD and not a mod on its own. To get these to work, go to the Stardew Valley Expansion mod in your mod files > [CP] SVE > assets > character files > portraits > replace existing character PNG files with the new ones.

As for the [b]JOJA vendor[/b] portraits for Claire and Martin, go to Stardew Valley Expansion mod > [ STF ] SVE > assets > Joja > replace existing vendor portraits for Claire and Martin.


Thank you for downloading my portraits!! Enjoy <3

--
